projectDescription: Avatar Factory is an all-in-one AI influencer studio that turns a character brief into finished short-form video reels — complete with generated face, voice, script, and scenes — without any filming, recording, or editing.
keyFeatures: AI Avatar Generator — build a character with a generated face, voice, backstory, and reference pack from a short brief or template
Video Wizard — three templates (UGC Reel, Two-Hander Podcast, Split-Window Reel) that take a script to a finished MP4 in under 3 minutes
Script sourcing — AI content expert brainstorming, reel/TikTok/YouTube transcription, Full Clone (shot-by-shot storyboard copy), or scratch
Cinematic motion shots powered by Kling v3 and talking-head shots powered by HeyGen Avatar IV
Image Studio — generate and save scenes, photos, and outfits; 6-angle Reference Pack for consistent avatar appearance across videos
Viral Radar — track competitor accounts, scan for outperforming reels, and surface trending hooks from 500M+ analyzed videos
Reel Analytics — filter, sort, and copy viral reels directly into the video wizard
Claude and ChatGPT MCP connectors — research trends, generate scripts, and hand off to the app for rendering from inside the chat
Free read-only Trends MCP connector — five tools for hook ideation and trend research with no payment required
Auto-captions with 8 burn-in styles, QA report, shot regeneration, and video editor
ElevenLabs voice integration — connect an API key to use any ElevenLabs voice on an avatar
Three-day $1 trial with full feature access across all plans
publicApiSurface: REST API access (Influencer plan only, manual setup via support)
